facts.text: The repository sets up a decentralised multi-robot exploration simulation with the 2D Stage simulator and a map from Google Cartographer.
The Stage launch starts the package's private stageros node against the shipped pioneer3dx-sick world file.
The shipped world places three pioneer3dx models named pioneer0, pioneer1 and pioneer2, each with a fixed pose and a fancysicklaser.
The shipped sicklaser ranger declares range [ 0.0 20.0 ], fov 365.0 and 1081 samples.
robot_assigner.launch sets the assigner's n_robots parameter to 2.
The multi-robot assigner launch includes robot_assigner.launch for robot index 0 and robot index 1.
StageNode::mapName returns the relative name robot_<id>/<name> when more than one position model is present, unless use_model_names is set and the model token has no colon.
SubscribeModels advertises nav_msgs/Odometry on the mapName(ODOM) topic for each position model, with queue length 10.
SubscribeModels creates a geometry_msgs/Twist subscription on the mapName(CMD_VEL) topic for each position model.
SubscribeModels advertises a sensor_msgs/LaserScan on the mapName(BASE_SCAN) topic for each laser model.
SubscribeModels advertises rosgraph_msgs/Clock on the absolute /clock topic.
SubscribeModels advertises the relative reset_positions service with std_srvs/Empty.
cmdvelReceived passes the Twist linear.x, linear.y and angular.z to ModelPosition::SetSpeed and records the simulated time of the last command.
WorldCallback zeroes every position model's speed only when base_watchdog_timeout is greater than 0 and the simulated time since the last command reaches that timeout.

WorldCallback sets odometry pose.pose.position.x and position.y from est_pose, twist.twist.linear.x, linear.y and angular.z from GetVelocity, and header.stamp from sim_time, then publishes the message.
base_watchdog_timeout is a ROS parameter whose default is 0.2 s when the parameter is not set.
cb_reset_srv sets every position model to its stored initial pose and clears SetStall, then returns true; it does not set the commanded speed to zero.
frontier_filter publishes the relative filtered_frontiers topic as frontier_exploration/PointArray.
The exploration launch reads /filtered_frontiers as the assigner's frontier topic.
multi_robot_navigation.launch includes navigation.launch with robot_name robot_0 and with robot_name robot_1.
navigation.launch starts move_base in the namespace given by robot_name.
MoveBase advertises a geometry_msgs::Twist publisher on the relative cmd_vel topic.
The assigner calls sendGoal.
The shipped pioneer3dx-sick world sets interval_sim 100.
A Stage world file in the clone comments that interval_sim 100 is a simulation timestep in milliseconds.

determinism.notes: Event-driven placeholder contract with no Stage step, no ray casting, no odometry integration and no pacing; the same command does not reproduce a Stage trajectory

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free rosbridge contract fake (no Stage, no physics)
gaps: the fake answers the declared ROS endpoints with placeholder messages; it runs no Stage world, no collision or laser ray casting, no odometry integration and no wall-clock pacing
the laser ranges, intensities, odometry poses and frontier points are test data, not a recording of a Stage run and not a physics result

robot_0_twist and robot_1_twist are the first sample of a new odometry subscription; the fake stores the last Twist it accepted on that robot's cmd_vel and reports it there, which is not GetVelocity and not a Stage measurement. A live subscriber receives the next WorldCallback publish, and the cmd_vel command does not wait for that publish
the real shipped world has 1081 laser samples and three position models; this package serves the two robots configured by the exploration launch and a fake array whose length is a placeholder
Cartographer mapping, the frontier detector, the frontier filter, move_base navigation and TF are outside this package

no acknowledged stop, pause or brake endpoint exists; the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, simulated only) that publishes a zero Twist on /robot_0/cmd_vel and /robot_1/cmd_vel and is achieved only when both odometry streams then stay at rest for three consecutive fresh samples; the thresholds are operator_required (fake placeholders in fixtures/estop-confirmation.json) and the client bounds are a package choice, so a live deployment sets both in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation']

the confirmation proves the sensed state over its window only: WorldCallback also zeroes every position model once base_watchdog_timeout (default 0.2 s when unset, and skipped when the parameter is 0) elapses without a command, so the robots can be at rest without the zero Twist having been applied; a publisher that refreshes cmd_vel, including move_base, keeps the watchdog from firing and the confirmation fails closed

the shipped world has three position models (pioneer0, pioneer1, pioneer2); this stop commands and senses only robot_0 and robot_1, the two the exploration launch configures, and pioneer2 is zeroed only by the watchdog

with multi_robot_navigation.launch running, move_base publishes cmd_vel in each robot namespace while the assigners send it goals through sendGoal; those publications compete with this package and the stop then fails closed; nothing watches the robots after the confirmation window

cb_reset_srv teleports every position model to its initial pose and clears stall without zeroing the commanded speed, so it is not bound as the reset and is not offered as a re-enable; the MHS reset re-confirms the sensed stop and changes nothing on the Stage models
the odometry advertise call passes queue length 10 and no latch argument; this is ROS 1, so the bridge discards the first sample and no history is declared

max - min of odom_0.pose.pose.position.y over the window <= r0_y
max - min of odom_1.pose.pose.position.x over the window <= r1_x
max - min of odom_1.pose.pose.position.y over the window <= r1_y

safe_state.description: Simulated only: zero Twists on /robot_0/cmd_vel and /robot_1/cmd_vel, then both odom streams at rest for three fresh samples within the operator bounds. The zero Twist proves nothing. The watchdog can rest every model, including unsensed pioneer2, without that request, and 0 disables it. move_base on the same cmd_vel topics (assigners call sendGoal) fails the confirmation closed. Nothing is claimed after the window. /reset_positions teleports and leaves the last speed, so it is not this reset.
